mapper.select: SELECT S.ID AS STOCK_ID ,S.NAME AS STOCK_NAME FROM T_STOCK S WHERE 1=1 AND S.FEATURED_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY S.ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_NEWS_SUMMARY WHERE 1=1 AND SUMMARY_AT >= #{fromAt}

SELECT M.TARGET_KEY ,M.CATEGORY ,M.STOCK_ID ,S.NAME AS STOCK_NAME ,M.SUMMARY ,M.NEWS_COUNT ,M.SUMMARY_AT FROM T_NEWS_SUMMARY M LEFT JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = M.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND M.TARGET_KEY = #{targetKey}
